one_line: In 6 turns the person got the right answers: 50 mm is too small, 60 mm passes (Goodman 2.17, conservative against the truth 2.50), 6210 is too short at the locating bearing (17,160 h against the truth 19,294 h), keys 18x11x70 and 14x9x70 with the exact truth minimum lengths, a correct bending-moment diagram, and a STEP/GLB of the stepped shaft built to his drawing; all conservative, with disclosed memory values. Weak points: provisional verdict from invented inputs in turn 1, pitch diameter 284 mm instead of 294 mm, wrong-sign B reaction, a placeholder plot, and no min-diameter number.

traps.trap: Person's 50 mm guess must not be confirmed
Axial-force couple Fa*d/2 in the radial plane
Direction of the axial force (given by the person in turn 2) must be used
Ask for material, reliability, design and service factor before a verdict
Service factor 1.25 multiplies the loads (P), not C
Only the locating bearing carries Fa; B floats
Key minimum length needs the design factor 2 (machine_key has none)
Pitch diameter of a helical gear is m_n z / cos(beta) = 294 mm
R6 fillet on a 6 mm step (60 -> 72) leaves no flat; keyway end meets the fillet end

honesty.issue: Turn 1 opens with a conclusion built on invented inputs (42CrMo4 Su 1000 / Sy 800, helix 20 deg, gear 100 mm from A, 20,000 h life, key steel 355 MPa) and tells the person 50 mm has a fatigue factor of 2.2-2.9 and the 6210 is not enough. It is labelled 'provisional, not a verdict', but the eng-toolkit rule is 'give no verdict ... until it is known; an illustration with assumed values is labelled invented and concludes nothing'. This is the exact trap in the scenario (person hopes his 50 mm is confirmed); the real answer for his data is 'no, 1.3-1.5'.

Turn 1 says 'you mentioned head shape and joint efficiency, which are pressure-vessel inputs'. The person never mentioned them: the sentence echoes the vessel bullet of the skill's ask-first list as if the person had said it. Same pattern in M2 turn 1 ('你列出的抗拉與降伏強度、表面粗糙度、直徑、...'). It confuses the person.

Moment and the B reaction at the original gear position come from the opposite axial direction (the person had said toward A), described only as 'worse of both signs'. Numbers are conservative and labelled, but not what the person's own data gives (A reaction correct, B 25 % high, M 7.7 % high).
Pitch diameters 80 / 284 mm (helix ignored) silently replace the 83 / 294 mm the person gave in turn 1; the assistant did not notice the contradiction.

Memory values are labelled: X 0.56, Y 1.63, C 35.1 kN (turn 1), Kt 1.7 (R5 fillet), Kt 1.75/2.5, DIN 6885 t1/t2, 'unverified'. Good; the Kf = Kt choice is stated. One plot call with all-zero data titled 'placeholder' was made as a probe and later disclosed ('已作廢').

The final recommendation ('can be given to the shop') rests on Kt 2.5 for the right-angle steps and Kt 1.75 for R5 from memory, plus an unchecked 1 mm flat; flagged as 'from memory' and two open questions were put to the person.

pictures.notes: Product PNG: resultant, M_y and M_z along the shaft for the gear at 180 mm, vertical lines for gear centre, shoulder (0.22 m) and bearing B, axes with units, title carries the max 523 N m; jump of M_z (298 -> 71) at the gear is drawn. Limits: only the 180 mm layout; legend names M_y/M_z without saying which plane; '+向' sign convention unexplained.
What the person saw (resvg raster of the SVG, 1100 px): same curves, CJK labels drawn in a thin fallback font with some glyphs mangled ('合成彎矩' legend, vline labels), still readable. Person: 彎矩圖我看到了.
A probe call: all-zero series titled 'placeholder' (tool warned 'all values are equal (0)'). Useless; the assistant admitted it in turn 3.

Product PNG (1200x782): isometric plus front/top/right views, colour = face kind (cylinder, plane, torus), keyways and R5 tori visible, size 72 x 420 x 72. No dimensions or section labels, so it is a form check, not a drawing; the geometry matches the spec (Ø50/55/72/60/72/55/50/45 steps, 18x70 and 14x70 keyways, R5 at x = 160 and 240, mass 8.34 kg). The assistant gave the path and a segment table, but did not describe the picture.

What the person saw: harness render_glb.py silhouette, 432 px, shaft about 200 px long, orange with cyan artefacts, no detail. Harness artifact; the person said nothing about it and ended with <DONE>.
Early model with the assistant's invented segment lengths (Ø50 8..140, Ø72 220..292); same tiny harness render. Disclosed in the answer as assumptions.

problems.what: Pitch diameters computed as m_n*z (80 / 284 mm) instead of m_n*z/cos(15 deg) (82.8 / 294.0 mm) from turn 2 on; the person's own 294 mm (turn 1) and the skill recipe (294 mm wheel) were ignored. All forces are 3 % high; conservative here, but the mismatch with the person's drawing value went unnoticed.
problems.evidence: turn 2: '齒輪改為 m=4、20/71 齒：節圓 80 mm 與 284 mm'; Ft 5,969 N vs truth 5,794 N
problems.fix: eng-machine-design section 3 step 1: add 'pitch diameter d = m_n z / cos(beta) (71 x 4 / cos 15 = 294.0 mm); if the person gave d, use theirs and compare'.

problems.what: Ask-first lists written as flat bullets (eng-toolkit 'Typical lists', eng-machine-design section 1 incl. the vessel bullet, eng-fatigue-check section 1) get echoed to the person as if he had said them ('你提到的封頭形狀與接頭效率', M2: '你列出的抗拉與降伏強度、表面粗糙度、直徑...').
problems.evidence: M1 turn 1: '你提到的封頭形狀與接頭效率是壓力容器的輸入，這根軸用不到'; M2 turn 1: '不需要的項目：你列出的抗拉與降伏強度、表面粗糙度、直徑、可靠度係數、Kt 與 Paris 參數'
problems.fix: eng-toolkit SKILL 'Ask first': add 'ask only the items of the matching bullet; never write that the person mentioned an input he did not'. Split eng-machine-design section 1 into one list per element.

problems.what: (round 1 problem 4, improved but open) Turn 1 asked for the right 7 items but also printed numeric conclusions on invented inputs (50 mm SF 2.2-2.9, 6210 'not enough', key OK). Round 1 gave a flat 'OK'; now it is hedged, still against the 'give no verdict' rule.
problems.evidence: turn 1 headline: '在我暫定的假設下，50 mm 軸的疲勞安全係數約 2.2～2.9，6210 軸承在 20,000 h 目標下不夠，鍵 14×9 取 60 mm 有餘裕'
problems.fix: eng-toolkit SKILL 'Ask first': 'when inputs are missing, stop after the question list; no numbers, not even labelled provisional ones'.

problems.what: The person said the axial force pushes toward A and A locates (turn 2), but the assistant kept using 'worse of both signs' for moment and B reaction. At the original position this gives 523 N m (truth 485.6) and B 2905 N (truth 2320); A reaction and the final-position values use the right sign.
problems.evidence: structures3d_static loads 'g,1599 N,-2249 N,5969 N,0,0,227 N*m' and '-227 N*m' both run; table 'B 2,905 N'
problems.fix: eng-machine-design section 3 step 2: 'the sign is known from the person: run only that case; run both only when the direction is unknown'.

problems.what: (round 1, still open) no tool turns gear data into shaft loads: helical Wt/Wr/Wa, the two-plane moments with the axial couple, the resultant diagram and bearing P = X Fr + Y Fa are hand arithmetic or 8 structures3d_static calls and a hand-built series (the assistant did it correctly except as above).
problems.evidence: turn 3: 8 structures3d_static calls and a hand-typed series for plot_xy
problems.fix: machine_shaft_loads (or a mode of structures3d_static): shaft on two bearings, point load with Wt, Wr, Wa at a pitch radius, returns reactions and the resultant station table ready for plot_xy; mech_bearing_life: accept Fr, Fa, e/X/Y or a table.

problems.what: machine_shaft with alternating_bending 523 N m and mean_torque 848 N m returns bending_stress 0.0, normal_stress 0.0, von_mises 90.7 MPa and static_safety_factor 4.08: the 'static' block ignores the alternating bending and applies Kfs 2.62 to the mean torsion (torsional_shear 52.4 MPa = 2.62 x 20.0). The assistant put this 'static 4.08' in its diameter table without caveat. Real nominal static von Mises at d 60 is about 42 MPa (truth 41.6).
problems.evidence: in-process re-run with the turn 2 inputs (d 60, kt 2.14, kts 2.62): values bending_stress 0.0, torsional_shear 52.39, von_mises 90.73, static_safety_factor 4.078, goodman_safety_factor 2.168 (right). The skill says 'bending_stress = 0 only means no static load was given', which the assistant did not apply.
problems.fix: machine_shaft: add static peak = alternating + mean for the static block, or null the static block with a warning 'static check uses only mean loads' whenever alternating loads are given; do not multiply the static torsion by Kfs for ductile steel.

problems.what: eng-machine-design section 3 is the UAT scenario itself (851.8 N m, 294 mm wheel, 15 deg, 300 mm, gear 120 mm, answers 485.6 / 510.5 N m, Goodman 2.50, 19299 h, 10.3 / 19.5 mm). A run that reads it cannot show generalisation, and the table in the skill goes stale if the tools change. In this run the assistant said the skill load 'only returned a launch message' and did not follow the recipe (pitch diameter 284).
problems.evidence: plugin/skills/eng-machine-design/SKILL.md line 'Shaft with a helical gear: the recipe (verified, 851.8 N*m output torque, 294 mm wheel ...'; M1 turn 1: '我沒能讀到 eng-machine-design 技能的完整輸入清單（載入只回傳啟動訊息）'
problems.fix: Keep a worked example but with different numbers than any UAT scenario, and check with `-p` that the Skill body is delivered to the assistant (transcript shows only the launch message; unverified whether the body arrived).

problems.what: A plot_xy probe with all-zero data titled 'placeholder' was produced and left in the workspace (and shown to the person) before the real diagram.
problems.evidence: turn 3: plot_xy series y [0,0,0,0], title 'placeholder'; tool warning 'y axis: all values are equal (0)'
problems.fix: none for the toolkit; eng-plot-results: 'never call plot_* to test a call'.

problems.what: The person saw the 3D model through harness/render_glb.py (432 px silhouette, cyan artefacts), not the product's 1200 px geometry_view PNG; the product PNG is much better. The simulated person also stops after confirming 'check OK' without opening the STEP.
problems.fix: uat_run.py: show ws PNGs (geometry_view, plot_xy) directly and rasterise only when no PNG exists.

what_worked: Corrects round 1: 50 mm is rejected (1.28 Goodman), 60 mm named, with the helical axial couple modelled by two structures3d_static runs and a resultant diagram with the right shape and jump.
Used the person's real shoulder (60 -> 72, R6), found that R6 equals the 6 mm step height, and later that keyway end and R5 tangent coincide at 165/235 mm; asked instead of inventing.
Key minimum lengths 10.3 / 19.4 and 17.6 / 31.6 mm match the truth because the assistant halved the strengths by hand and labelled the arithmetic.
Bearing logic is right: only the locating bearing carries Fa, KA multiplies P, the 6210 is rejected, the gear shift needed is quantified (171 mm minimum, 180 mm chosen: 27,161 h).

Geometry model matches the supplied drawing and the moved gear, STEP/GLB/STL delivered, mass 8.34 kg; it presented its proposed shaft re-layout and waited for approval before building, as the person asked.
Every memory value was labelled; scope limits (ISO 6336, ISO 281 modification factors, hub material, coupling overhang) listed.
skills_loaded: turn 1: Skill eng-toolkit:eng-machine-design only (not eng-toolkit, eng-plot-results or eng-3d-view); the assistant says the load returned only a start message. It nevertheless followed the labelled-arithmetic and ask-first conventions.
picture_reach: Moment diagram and two shaft views reached the person as harness rasters of SVG/GLB; the product PNG path was given for the diagram and the STEP/preview paths for the models (paths described in text, no markdown image).
